metadata.description: Interleaved RGB8 VLM center-crop regression coverage for fallback geometry. The 64-image batch targets about 1.5 ms for the 224-pixel crop on A100 to limit relative host-submission overhead in C++/Python comparisons. Output shapes retain adaptive row and width boundary coverage. Planar paths remain covered by the existing planar benchmark families.
